title: 第七章 老张下山 我要除魔第八章 突飞猛进
content_zh:
字认识。
看得进去，记忆也非常好。
最关键的是，能够提升悟性。
林凡也有两辈子的超强逻辑思维能力，再加上天赋影响，以及宋青书的不时讲解。
傍晚时，五行基础理论这本书，他已经吃透了七七八八。
结果，悟性：+1。
“这提升是不是太快了些？”
林凡有种头皮发麻的感觉。
毕竟普通人的悟性只有五点。
他一天就给加了两点。
“小师叔，你以前真没学过？”宋青书神情复杂。
“没有，第一次学习。”林凡笑道，“不过，这些理论性的东西，平时都接触过，如今系统学习，自然也就快了。明天再巩固巩固，后天就学经脉学。争取五天之内，将这些全部吃透。”
“好！”宋青书有些恍惚。
晚饭后，林凡被老张叫走。
“山上可还习惯？”院子里，老张毫无形象的坐在台阶上，让林凡坐在旁边。
“还行。”林凡点头，“既来之，则安之，我很乐观的。”
“乐观好，乐观才能活得久。”老张不禁笑道，“青书那孩子怎么样？能不能教育好？”
“我给他讲了舔狗的故事，一天一个，争取让他听到吐。”
“舔狗？”
老张不解。

林凡解释。
“舔狗，还真是、真是形象。”老张神情古怪，“你小子，这一招诛心啊，要是还改变不了，将来废了就是。”
“那可是三代首徒，算是嫡长孙，你真的舍得？”林凡倒没有多少意外。
“及时止损。”
“您老果决。要不，您老将那小姑娘提前找到，然后带回山门给青书当个童养媳？”
“好方法！”
老张眼睛亮了。
林凡嘴角扯了扯。
两人一老一少，天南海北的聊着。
老张人老成精，知道了林凡的大致底细后，放的开，也不摆架子。林凡没有多少敬畏之心，也彻底放开，奇思妙语无数。
特别是关于太极之理，也说了不少。
“你就是个瓶子！”几番言语下来，老张忽然指着他道。
“师尊，您老什么意思？”林凡疑惑。
怎么感觉是在骂他？
“外表光鲜，内里空空。”老张吹胡子瞪眼，“帖子上那几句，是你特意找的吧！”
林凡尴尬又不失礼貌地笑笑。
三个世界第一次出现后，他就有意准备。
content_en:
Word recognition.
It's easy to see and remember very well.
The most important thing is to improve your understanding.
Lin Fan also has two lifetimes of super logical thinking ability, coupled with the influence of his talent and Song Qingshu's constant explanations.
By evening, he had thoroughly read through the book Basic Theory of the Five Elements.
Result: Comprehension: +1.
"Is this improvement too fast?"
Lin Fan felt like his scalp was numb.
After all, ordinary people only have five points of understanding.
He added two points in one day.
"Uncle Junior, have you really never learned anything before?" Song Qingshu had a complicated expression.
"No, this is my first time learning." Lin Fan said with a smile, "However, I have been exposed to these theoretical things in daily life, and now I am learning systematically, so naturally it will be faster. I will consolidate it tomorrow, and learn about meridians the day after tomorrow. Try to understand them all within five days."
"Okay!" Song Qingshu was in a daze.
After dinner, Lin Fan was called away by Lao Zhang.
"Are you still used to the mountain?" In the yard, Lao Zhang sat on the steps without any image, and asked Lin Fan to sit next to him.
"It's not bad." Lin Fan nodded, "Now that it's here, let's make peace with it. I'm very optimistic."
"It's good to be optimistic. Only by being optimistic can you live longer." Lao Zhang couldn't help but smile, "How about Qingshu's child? Can he be educated well?"
"I told him stories about dog licking, one story a day, trying to make him vomit after hearing it."
"Dog licking?"
Lao Zhang was puzzled.
Lin Fan explained.
"Licking a dog is really, really an image." Lao Zhang looked strange, "You kid, this move is so heart-breaking. If you still can't change it, I'll be done with it in the future."
"That is the first disciple of the third generation, and he is considered the eldest grandson. Are you really willing to give it up?" Lin Fan was not surprised at all.
"Stop losses in time."
"You are decisive. How about you find the little girl in advance and bring her back to the mountain gate to be a child bride for Qingshu?"
"Good idea!"
Lao Zhang's eyes lit up.
Lin Fan twitched the corners of his mouth.
The two of them, one old and the other young, chatted all over the world.
Lao Zhang was a mature man. After knowing the general details of Lin Fan, he relaxed and didn't put on airs. Lin Fan didn't have much awe, but he was completely relaxed and had countless wonderful words.
In particular, a lot has been said about the principles of Tai Chi.
"You are just a bottle!" After several words, Lao Zhang suddenly pointed at him and said.
"Master, what do you mean?" Lin Fan was confused.
Why does it feel like you are scolding him?
"It's bright on the outside but empty on the inside." Lao Zhang blew his beard and glared, "You must have found those sentences on the post specially!"
Lin Fan smiled awkwardly but politely.
After the three worlds first appeared, he deliberately prepared.
